affordable.zh: 負擔得起的、價格實惠的

ex.en: The laptop provides cutting-edge technology at an affordable price.
ex.zh: 這台筆電以實惠的價格提供尖端技術。

ex.en: It's hard to find affordable housing in Taipei.
ex.zh: 在台北很難找到負擔得起的住房。

ex.en: The hotel offers clean rooms at affordable prices.
ex.zh: 這家飯店以實惠的價格提供乾淨的房間。

ex.en: I studied for more than two hours, and afterward I went to bed.
ex.zh: 我讀了兩個多小時的書，之後就去睡了。

ex.en: I fixed my car last month, but it broke again afterwards.
ex.zh: 我上個月把車修好了，但後來又壞了。

ex.en: If you use the toilet, flush it afterward.
ex.zh: 使用廁所後請沖水。

ex.en: She gave an affirmative answer.
ex.zh: 她給了肯定的答覆。

ex.en: The answer to both questions was affirmative.
ex.zh: 兩個問題的答案都是肯定的。

ex.en: Our company and its affiliates may share your personal information with each other.
ex.zh: 本公司與關係企業之間可能會共享你的個人資料。

ex.en: The bank has affiliates in over twenty countries.
ex.zh: 這家銀行在二十多個國家設有關係企業。

affiliate.zh: 使隸屬、使加入（常用被動 be affiliated with）

ex.en: The hospital is affiliated with a local university.
ex.zh: 這家醫院隸屬於當地一所大學。

ex.en: He is not affiliated with any political party.
ex.zh: 他沒有加入任何政黨。

ex.en: You must be tired after such a long trip.
ex.zh: 這麼長的旅程之後，你一定很累了。

ex.en: After the exam we compared the answers we'd written.
ex.zh: 考試後，我們對了彼此寫的答案。

ex.en: After a while, the man came into the room.
ex.zh: 過了一會兒，那個人走進了房間。

ex.en: The fire broke out after the staff went home.
ex.zh: 員工下班回家後，發生了火災。

ex.en: Call me after you arrive.
ex.zh: 你到了之後打電話給我。

ex.en: The schedule is only slightly affected by this delay.
ex.zh: 這次延誤對時程只有輕微影響。

ex.en: Other people's expectations affect how we behave.
ex.zh: 別人的期望會影響我們的行為。

ex.en: Imagination affects every aspect of our lives.
ex.zh: 想像力影響我們生活的每個層面。

ex.en: The weather will change for the worse this afternoon.
ex.zh: 今天下午天氣會變差。

ex.en: We have no classes on Wednesday afternoons.
ex.zh: 我們週三下午沒課。

ex.en: In the afternoon I must arrange for the trip.
ex.zh: 下午我得為旅行做準備。

ex.en: Don't be afraid to make mistakes when speaking English.
ex.zh: 說英語時不要怕犯錯。

ex.en: I am not in the least afraid of dogs.
ex.zh: 我一點也不怕狗。

ex.en: I'm afraid I differ with you on this point.
ex.zh: 恐怕在這一點上，我和你意見不同。

ex.en: "Will they go on strike again?" "I'm afraid so."
ex.zh: 「他們又要罷工了嗎？」「恐怕是的。」

ex.en: "Will he pass the examination?" "I am afraid not."
ex.zh: 「他會通過考試嗎？」「恐怕不會。」

ex.en: He has no right to interfere in our family affairs.
ex.zh: 他無權干涉我們的家務事。

ex.en: She handles the company's financial affairs.
ex.zh: 她負責處理公司的財務事宜。

ex.en: The minister is in charge of foreign affairs.
ex.zh: 這位部長負責外交事務。

ex.en: I have nothing to do with the affair.
ex.zh: 我跟這件事無關。

ex.en: I don't want to be involved in this affair.
ex.zh: 我可不想捲入這件事。

ex.en: He had an affair with a coworker.
ex.zh: 他和一位同事有外遇。

ex.en: Their marriage ended after her affair.
ex.zh: 她外遇之後，他們的婚姻就結束了。

ex.en: The CEO affirmed the company's commitment to quality.
ex.zh: 執行長重申公司對品質的承諾。

ex.en: The court affirmed the earlier decision.
ex.zh: 法院維持了先前的判決。

ex.en: The clinic is affiliated with a university hospital.
ex.zh: 這間診所隸屬於一家大學附設醫院。

ex.en: Our company is not affiliated with that website.
ex.zh: 本公司與那個網站沒有任何關係。

ex.en: I can't afford to buy such an expensive car.
ex.zh: 我買不起這麼貴的車。

ex.en: Jack can't afford to buy a new bicycle.
ex.zh: 傑克買不起新腳踏車。

ex.en: I can't afford a new car this year.
ex.zh: 我今年買不起新車。

afford.zh: can't afford to：承擔不起（後果）

ex.en: We can't afford to make any more mistakes.
ex.zh: 我們再也承擔不起任何錯誤了。

ex.en: You can't afford to miss this opportunity.
ex.zh: 這個機會你可千萬不能錯過。

ex.en: Everyone knows of his affection for that dog.
ex.zh: 大家都知道他很疼愛那隻狗。

ex.en: Every mother has affection for her child.
ex.zh: 每個母親都疼愛自己的孩子。

ex.en: This brand is known for its excellent after-sales service.
ex.zh: 這個品牌以優質的售後服務聞名。

ex.en: Contact after-sales service if the product breaks.
ex.zh: 產品故障時請聯絡售後服務。

ex.en: Please refer to the aforementioned policy.
ex.zh: 請參閱前述政策。

ex.en: The aforementioned items will arrive tomorrow.
ex.zh: 上述物品明天會送達。
